release_baseline: 0.1.56; B001; no full regression or wheel build

facets.inputs: Analytic rectangular box; owned tetrahedron ASCII STL with vertices (0,0,0),(2,0,0),(0,3,0),(0,0,4), translated (3,0,5), tilted 30 degrees about Y; explicit ObjectIsADetector=true.
facets.checks: Local/global bounds, all STL vertices and cross-product normals, triangle areas, pagination, cursor/frame restoration, model preservation and save/reload. Absorbing box independent 1W incident and absorbed flux sums. Borrowed IFaceData has no Close; owning stdio application disconnected successfully.
facets.fix: Native global GetVertexNormal includes object translation. Return rotation times local normal; retain raw native_vertex_normals and normal_source. No implicit detector-mode mutation.
facets.resources: Owned STL copied into run evidence and deleted from user CAD resource directory after native close. Fresh CAD reload initializes inactive spectral fields; comparisons start from saved/reloaded baseline.

regions.checks: Rectangle flux/irradiance/intensity and volume flux/absorbed_flux/absorbed_density bounded regions match corresponding native full-grid slices. Independent point-ray occupied cell is 1 W. Save/reload baseline, source model retained, no full allocation for 128 cubed detector corner cell, normal application disconnect.
regions.result_scope: Partial region only; incident voxel flux repeats along paths. Absorbed quantities in this nonabsorbing detector cross-check are zero; full-reader physical absorption references retain their existing independent scope.

sag.reference: StandardLens R1=50 mm, front sag 50-sqrt(2500-x*x-y*y), planar rear after native Offset=2 mm. Five 33x33 maps: front/rear, keep_zrd off/on, asymmetric decenter (+.5,-.25).
sag.checks: 5445 analytic point comparisons, fixed tolerance 1e-8 + 1e-7 * abs(reference), save/reload baseline, setting readback, grid orientation, pagination, five PNG exports, both generated ZRDs parsed, source model retained. All-invalid face returns NO_RESULT_DATA with raw artifacts; next valid analysis succeeds. Running 1025x1025 cancellation returns cancelled, closes, preserves model and allows next analysis.
fixes: ZRDFilename requires file name beside SystemFile, not an absolute path
All-invalid native grids are rejected with original text/messages retained
Return valid/invalid sample counts, lens units and confirmed values[y][x] axes
sag.coordinates: Width=2 yields native endpoint grid -2..2, step .125. Native decenter is added to sampling-plane coordinates in the tested untilted sphere case; arbitrary object tilts remain governed by retained native settings.
